Container.Name: youtube-dl
Container.Overview: Automated yt-dlp container for downloading YouTube channels/subscriptions on an interval, with an optional webui, moving completed downloads to a separate folder, and extracting audio to mp3.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port the webui is served on (requires youtubedl_webui=true below). 8080 is commonly taken by other containers (e.g. sabnzbd) - check for conflicts before applying.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where videos are downloaded to

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent config storage: args.conf, channels.txt, cookies.txt, archive.txt

Config.Name: Completed
Config.Description: Finished downloads are moved here when youtubedl_move_completed is enabled

Config.Name: Audio
Config.Description: Extracted mp3 audio is saved here when youtubedl_extract_audio is enabled

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, used for correct log timestamps

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UserID for file permissions

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GroupID for file permissions

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: umask for file permissions

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: Enable verbose logging

Config.Name: Lockfile
Config.Description: Create youtubedl-running / youtubedl-completed marker files in /downloads for external scripts

Config.Name: WebUI Enabled
Config.Description: Enable the webui

Config.Name: WebUI Path
Config.Description: Path prefix to serve the webui from, for path-based reverse proxies

Config.Name: WebUI Internal Port
Config.Description: Internal port the webui listens on (must match the WebUI Port mapping above)

Config.Name: Subscriptions
Config.Description: Download all your YouTube subscriptions (requires cookies.txt in /config)

Config.Name: Watch Later
Config.Description: Download your Watch Later playlist (requires cookies.txt in /config)

Config.Name: Interval
Config.Description: Download interval, e.g. 1h, 3h, 12h, 3d; or false to run once and exit

Config.Name: Quality
Config.Description: Max download resolution in pixels: 720, 1080, 1440, 2160 (no trailing 'p')

Config.Name: Move Completed
Config.Description: Move finished downloads out of /downloads into /completed at the end of every download cycle

Config.Name: Extract Audio
Config.Description: Extract mp3 audio for every downloaded video into /audio, keeping the original video
